documentation: Timing and process exit map onto Lua's os library: measure* time the block with os.clock (CPU time, the best Lua 5.1 offers), getTime* read os.time (whole seconds in real Lua), exitProcess is os.exit.

declarations.name: measureTimeMillis
declarations.documentation: Runs the block and returns the elapsed os.clock time in milliseconds

declarations.name: measureNanoTime
declarations.documentation: Runs the block and returns the elapsed os.clock time in nanoseconds

declarations.name: getTimeMillis
declarations.documentation: math.floor(os.time() * 1000); real Lua only has whole-second resolution

declarations.name: getTimeMicros
declarations.documentation: math.floor(os.time() * 1000000); real Lua only has whole-second resolution

declarations.name: getTimeNanos
declarations.documentation: math.floor(os.time() * 1000000000); real Lua only has whole-second resolution

declarations.name: measureTimeMicros
declarations.documentation: Runs the block and returns the elapsed os.clock time in microseconds
